## Project background

Please tell us what the project is for and how long it has been available. An approximate date is fine. If you don't know, say so.

- Main idea: What does the project aim to achieve, and how does it help users?

Maintainers review the application and decide which list fits. Its age provides context, but does not determine placement.

## Checklist

- [ ] I explained the project's main idea and how it helps users, and gave its first release date as accurately as I could, or marked it as unknown.
- [ ] The application loads, works, and has an English interface.
- [ ] It performs calculations itself. It is not a library, API, article, tutorial, or thin SEO page.
- [ ] I checked the platforms, current price, license, and source against the application's official pages and included pricing and license links above.
- [ ] I added one application, placed it alphabetically, and followed the existing entry format.
- [ ] The entry links only the application name and optional source. Prices and licenses are plain text.
- [ ] I checked all lists for duplicates and updated the category's Emerging link if needed.
- [ ] The description is brief and factual, starts with a capital letter, and ends with a period.
- [ ] I stated any affiliation above.
- [ ] I ran `npm test`.
